mapper.select: SELECT game_id, rune_key, name, description, category, created_at, updated_at FROM public.runes WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND rune_key = #{runeKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.runes (game_id, rune_key, name, description, category) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{runeKey}, #{name}, #{description}, #{category})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM public.runes WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND rune_key = #{runeKey}
mapper.select: SELECT game_id, path_key, name, description, kind, sort_order, slots::text AS slots_json, created_at, updated_at FROM public.rune_paths WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND path_key = #{pathKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.rune_paths (game_id, path_key, name, description, kind, sort_order, slots) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{pathKey}, #{name}, #{description}, #{kind}, #{sortOrder}, CAST(#{slotsJson} AS jsonb))
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM public.rune_paths WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND path_key = #{pathKey}
